scenario: how many people are in the family
english_title: Recognising and Responding to How Many People Are in the Family
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: family & relationships — how many people are in the family
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to how many people are in the family; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Mr Daniel asks Ms Lan how many people are in her household.
context_note_vi: Anh Daniel hỏi chị Lan gia đình có bao nhiêu người.

turns.speaker: Mr Daniel
turns.english: Lan, how many people are in your household?
turns.vietnamese: Lan này, gia đình chị có bao nhiêu người?

turns.speaker: Mr Daniel
turns.vietnamese: Ba người à. Ấm cúng nhỉ.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.vietnamese: Vâng, vừa đủ cho gia đình tôi.
